timeline.suggestion: A young child observing their parent's stressed facial expression while scrolling on a phone. Camera: slow push-in on the child's face from a low angle. Soft, diffused living room light.
A child at a kitchen table subtly mimicking their parent's hunched, tense posture. Camera: quick track from behind the child to reveal the matching posture. Bright kitchen window light.
Close-up of a printed child's astrological chart, with a translucent overlay of a parent's chart showing shared aspects. Camera: slow zoom on the overlapping planetary symbols. Warm desk lamp glow.

A mother holding a toddler, looking out a window with a cautious, slightly fearful expression. Camera: gentle pull-back from mother and child to show the external world. Soft daylight through curtains.

A child hesitating at an open doorway to a bright, inviting room, then nervously turning away. Camera: slow dolly forward, then quick pull-back as the child retreats. Natural hallway light with a bright room beyond.

A parent and child holding hands, walking joyfully towards a wide-open, sunlit space with a clear blue sky. Camera: sweeping crane shot from behind, revealing the expansive, hopeful view. Golden hour sunlight.
